timing_recheck.method: One predeclared conservative clock recheck; same placed/routed netlist, no datapath change and no frequency sweep. No inferred Fmax from negative slack.
limitations: Only constrained internal OOC paths; unconstrained external I/O delays are listed explicitly.
OOC clock port has no integrated HD.CLK_SRC; system clock insertion/skew and AXI integration remain unverified.
Not board timing or calibrated memory timing.

monitor.verification: Memory result traces are byte-identical. Scalar status trace tokens including exact value bits and transaction IDs match; only scalar separator whitespace is ignored. Raw simulation and original receipt unchanged.
